# mp-darkmode 1.2.2

WeChat's dark-mode conversion for rich-text HTML (MIT, see LICENSE), used by the mail
reader to recolour HTML email in dark mode. Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mp-darkmode
(`dist/darkmode.min.js`, sha256 3c562121f33ff7f56f5a6c1dcce1de7b63af01582ddc96377458d8f0652d2ce4
for 1.2.2's tarball as downloaded 2026-10-06).

The app embeds it as `Sources/PlainpostUI/Vendor/MPDarkmodeScript.swift`, generated by
`Scripts/vendor-mp-darkmode.sh` from the files here. To update: replace `darkmode.min.js`
and `LICENSE` with a new release's, update this file, and rerun the script.
